title: Relative skeletal filtration for weighted Reedy coends
statement:
Let $J$ be a small ordinary category and $\mathcal C$ a cocomplete category, with all diagrams and Hom sets in containing universes. Use the simplex category, simplicial sets and boundaries of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set] and latching indexing categories of [lem-coef-reedy-model-structure]. For $X:J\to\mathcal C$ and $S:J^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Set}$ put $X\odot_JS=\int^{j\in J}\coprod_{S(j)}X(j)$, the coproduct modulo the arrow relations. For a cosimplicial diagram $A:\Delta\to\mathcal C^J$ and simplicial presheaf $K:J^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{sSet}$ put $E(A,K)=\int^{[n]\in\Delta}A^n\odot_JK_n$, imposing the simplex-operator relations. Let $f:A\to B$ and $i:K\to L$ be arbitrary maps. Write $\lambda_n f:A^n\amalg_{L_nA}L_nB\to B^n$ for the relative cosimplicial latching map. Write $D_nK$ for the simplicial latching presheaf of sets (the colimit over proper surjections $[n]\twoheadrightarrow[r]$), and $\delta_ni:K_n\amalg_{D_nK}D_nL\to L_n$ for its relative latching map; here $L_n$ on the right is the degree-$n$ presheaf of $L$, not a latching object. For maps $u:X\to Y$, $v:S\to T$, define
$$u\mathbin\square_Jv:(Y\odot_JS)\amalg_{X\odot_JS}(X\odot_JT)\longrightarrow Y\odot_JT.$$
The corner map
$$E(A,L)\amalg_{E(A,K)}E(B,K)\longrightarrow E(B,L)$$
has a natural countable filtration starting at its domain and with colimit its codomain, whose degree-$n$ transition is a pushout of $\lambda_nf\mathbin\square_J\delta_ni$. The assertion includes $n=0$, with both latching diagrams initial, and $J=\varnothing$. No model structure, enrichment, cofibrancy or monomorphism hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Hirschhorn, Model Categories and Their Localizations, §§16.4–16.5 and 19.2–19.4. Agent adaptation; the scanned source is retained in the sandbox. No Stacks tag states this construction. Pure colimit calculation underlying the relative-latching lifting argument of §16.4 and Lemma 19.2.14; not a homotopy-invariance assertion.
